findings.mechanism: Subprocess leak on partial Start() failure: cmd.Start() succeeds but t.running is set after, leaving a window where a panic in relay goroutines could orphan the subprocess without Close() being called.
findings.test: go test -run TestStdioTransport_StartFailure ./internal/tools/mcp/transport/... and check for orphaned processes
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- stdio.go:129-142 shows cmd.Start() precedes t.running.Store(true)

findings.mechanism: working_dir path traversal not blocked when fenceChecker is nil: resolvePath returns absolute path but no containment check runs if fenceChecker is unconfigured.
findings.test: Call ShellExecuteTool.Execute with working_dir: "../../" and verify fence checker invocation
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- shell.go:402-409 shows resolvePath called, then fenceChecker check at line 412; if nil, no containment validation

findings.mechanism: ExecuteWithRetry masks non-retryable errors with 'unknown error during tool execution' when result.Success is false but err is nil.
findings.test: Register tool returning ToolResult{Success: false, Error: 'specific failure'} and call ExecuteWithRetry; error message will be generic
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- registry.go:576-587 shows lastErr set to generic message when result.Success is false

findings.mechanism: MCP tool response content not tainted: CallTool returns success result without taint.TaintExternal label, treating MCP server output as trusted.
findings.test: Connect malicious MCP server returning injected instructions; verify agent treats content as trusted
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- client.go:316-321 shows NewSuccessResult(resultText) with no taint labeling
